span.label: Declarative memory works by binding items to each other, to their context and to neighbouring events, which is what makes it relational

span.label: False memory is a failure of that same relational machinery rather than a separate defect - the network returns relations that never occurred

span.label: The timing of that blockade separates the two kinds of memory: it stops permanent fixation and leaves initial learning and short-term memory intact

span.label: The systems are described as distinct while also interacting and storing the same event separately, so the boundaries are functional rather than sharp
span.note: what this limits: any claim that the memory systems are separable: THE PROCEDURAL AND EMOTIONAL MEMORY SYSTEMS CAN STORE AND DISTINCTLY EXPRESS DIFFERENT FORMS OF MEMORY EVEN FOR THE SAME EVENT - distinct and simultaneously overlapping

span.label: Implicit memory is characterised as a variety of systems rather than one, so the category is defined by what it is not
span.note: what this limits: the category implicit memory itself: THESE VARIOUS FORMS OF IMPLICIT MEMORY ARE SUPPORTED BY A VARIETY OF MEMORY SYSTEMS - it is not one system but the residue left when declarative memory is removed

span.label: episodic memory —is-a→ associative memory
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.9 — REPLACES concept_edges[1], which typed episodic memory as a kind of DECLARATIVE memory. That is true of the field and this paper does not say it: the only sentence in the staged body placing episodic memory under a superclass places it under ASSOCIATIVE memory. The old edge is withdrawn, not corrected in place, because its `to` was wrong rather than its quote. NO `relation`/`relation_evidence` ON THIS EDGE, DELIBERATELY: the sentence's class cue is `the most complex FORMS OF associative memory`, and the gate's is-a cue list holds `a form of` but not `forms of`. That is Q-1201 exactly - the cue vocabulary lacks the plural of a form it already accepts - and I am not editing the cue lists, which have two named amenders. The edge therefore joins the 92% that carry a span and no marked clause. Add the clause when the vocabulary is widened.
